title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Plant MagAttract v.5
author: Graeme Oatley

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix in a 50 mL centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the lysis buffer on a 65 °C heat block and incubate at 400 rpm for at least 20 minutes.
Keep at temperature until added to the sample.
Immediately prior to initiating lysis, add 20 µL Proteinase K (for n+1 samples) to the preheated lysis buffer and swirl the tube to mix.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 mg of cryogenically disrupted tissue from each sample to 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Ensure tissue is completely disrupted into a fine powder; any samples with 'chunks' must be further cryogenically disrupted.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Initiate lysis by adding preheated buffer and incubating on a heat block.

substeps.instruction: Add 370 µL of the preheated lysis buffer plus Proteinase K to each sample.
Immediately homogenize the lysate using 5 rapid pulse vortexes.
Place on the 55 °C heat block at 600 rpm for 15 minutes.

steps.title: RNase Treatment and Extended Lysis
steps.instruction: Treat samples with RNase A and continue incubation.

substeps.instruction: After the initial 15 minute incubation, add 4 µL RNase A to each sample.
Mix thoroughly by inversion until aggregated, insoluble, or sedimented tissue particles are resuspended.
Incubate for 5 minutes; if samples are severely aggregated, resuspend using a wide-bore pipette tip.
Incubate samples for a further 45 minutes on the heat block at 55 °C at 600 rpm.

steps.title: Final Lysis Sedimentation
steps.instruction: Allow tissue particles to settle to prevent gDNA loss.

substeps.instruction: For the final 15 minutes of lysis, remove the 600 rpm mixing from the heat block to allow particles to settle at the bottom of the tube.
Remove sample tubes from the heat block and allow lysate to settle for 5 minutes.
Transfer samples to a pre-chilled cold block on wet ice and incubate for 10 minutes to equilibrate temperature.
Centrifuge the samples at 8000 rpm for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: KingFisher DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform automated DNA extraction using the KingFisher™ Apex.

substeps.instruction: Label nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates and fill the required number of wells.
Using a wide-bore pipette tip, transfer 380 µL of lysate from sample tubes to individual wells in the sample plate, avoiding large debris.
Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Select the required DNA extraction protocol from the list and press the play button.
The protocol begins automatically once the final plate is loaded (approximately 40 minutes).
Follow on-screen instructions to remove plates; retain the Tip Plate containing the tip comb.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA overnight and collect beads.

substeps.instruction: Seal the Elution Plate with a plate seal and leave overnight at room temperature.
The following morning, remove the plate seal and return to the KingFisher™ Apex.
Load the Tip Plate and Elution Plate as prompted and run the 'bead collection' protocol.
Once the bead collection protocol completes (approximately 5 minutes), follow on-screen instructions to remove plates.

steps.title: Eluate Quality Control and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Inspect eluate and prepare for SPRI.

substeps.instruction: Inspect the Elution Plate for remaining magnetic beads. If beads are present, transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes, and collect the clear eluate using a wide-bore pipette tip before returning to the original well.
Using a wide-bore pipette tip, transfer 130 µL of eluate from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: 0.45X SPRI Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform 0.45X SPRI cleanup using the KingFisher™ Apex.

substeps.instruction: Set up the KingFisher™ plates for the 0.45X SPRI (the Elution Plate from the previous step is now the 'Sample Plate').
Load the filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Select the required 0.45X SPRI protocol and press the play button.
The protocol begins automatically once the final plate is loaded (approximately 50 minutes).
Follow on-screen instructions to remove plates once the protocol is complete.

steps.title: Final Storage and QC
steps.instruction: Store the extracted DNA and verify quality.

substeps.instruction: Store the DNA at 4 ºC.
Perform the required QC to determine the quantity and quality of the extracted DNA.
